title: LED Camping Lantern – Solar-Charged & Foldable
descriptionHtml:
Cozy, reliable light in the tent

At the campsite it is hard to find anything once darkness falls. And battery lamps easily run out just when you need them most.

Solar-charged and foldable

This camping lantern is charged by the sun and has several light modes. It folds up and is easy to hang in the tent or at the campsite.

Features

  • Charged by solar cells
  • Several light modes
  • Foldable and easy to hang
  • Easy to pack for the trip
  • Great for camping, hiking and emergency lighting

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
